description: Shrub, up to 3.5 m high; branchlets puberulous. Stipules triangular, 1.1–2.3 mm long. Leaves: petiole (0.5–)1–2 cm long, puberulous, glabrescent; blade obovate to oblanceolate, 9.3–20 by 3–7 cm, membranous to chartaceous, glabrescent, base rounded or obtuse, margin shallowly and distantly crenate-dentate, apex shortly caudate or acuminate-obtuse; nerves in 9–14 pairs, venation trinerved at base. Staminate inflorescences cauliflorous, slender, branched. Staminate flowers: pedicel ca 1 cm long; sepals obovate, oblong or ovate oblong, sparsely hairy on the back, ca 2.5 by 2 mm; petals oblancelolate, ca 2 by 1.5 mm; disc copular, 5-lobed; stamens 3; staminal column ca 0.5 mm long; anthers ca 0.1 mm long. Pistillate inflorescences almost simple, slender, axillary, few-flowered, up to 6 cm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 9–10 mm long, elongate; sepals unequal, glabrous inside, sparsely hairy outside, rim membranous, fimbriate, 2 larger, 4.7–5 by ca 2 mm, 3 smaller, 3.7–3.8 by ca 1.5 mm; petals oblong lanceolate, ca 1.8 by 1 mm, purplish-red or red; disc copular, 5-lobed; ovary puberulous; style ca 0.8 mm long. Fruits: pedicel ca 1 cm long; capsule globose, 16–21 by 4–7 mm, minutely adpressed puberulous with accrescent calyx.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub, up to 1 m high; branchlets terete, densely ferrugineous hairy. Stipules caducous. Leaves: petiole 3-6 mm long, densely ferrugineous; blade oblanceolate, 10–35 by 4–7 cm, membranous to chartaceous, base obtuse, margin ciliate and strongly denticulate, apex acuminate, nerves in 10–15 pairs. Inflorescences racemose, axillary, up to 2.5 cm long, few flowered, ciliate; bracteoles lanceolate or falcate acuminate, ciliate, 10–15 by 4–5 mm. Staminate flowers: sepals ovate or oblong elliptic, margin ciliate, 3 larger ca 2.5 mm long, 2 smaller ca 1.5 mm long; petals elliptic or ovate, ca 4 by 2.5 mm; disc glands 5; stamens 3; staminal column ca 0.5 mm long; anther ca 0.5 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel short; solitary; sepals lanceolate with long ciliate acuminate, ca 5 mm long; petals elliptic or obovate elliptic, 4.5–5 by ca 4 mm, glabrous, purplish; disc glands 5, oblong; style ca 1 mm long. Fruits unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub, up to 4 m high; branchlets terete or angled, hirsute, glabrescent. Stipules triangular or lanceolate, ca 2 mm long. Leaves: petiole (0.3–)1.5–3(–3.8)cm long, glabrescent; blade narrowly elliptic, lanceolate or oblanceolate, 8–20 by 2.4–5 cm, thinly chartaceous or chartaceous, sparsely hairy, glabrescent, base cuneate, margin minutely denticulate, apex or obtuse-acuminate, nerves in 8–16 pairs; venation penninerved. Staminate inflorescences racemose, axillary, up to 8 cm long; peduncle & branches shortly adpressed hirsute; bracteoles ca 3 mm long. Staminate flowers: pedicel 6–10 mm long, glabrous or sparsely hairy; sepals obovate, 1.5–2 by 1.2–1.5 mm, adpressed hirsute outside; petals obovate or rotund-obovate, ca 3.5 by 2.5 mm, dull red; disc glands 5; stamens 3; staminal column ca 1.5 mm long; anther ca 0.5 mm long. Pistillate inflorescences racemose, axillary, up to 17 cm long; bracteoles oblanceolate or ovate, 4.3–5.6 by 0.8–1.5 mm, glabrous inside, hairy outside. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 1.5–2.5 mm long; sepals fringed with elongate capitate glands; petals ovate or oblong, 4.3–5 by 2 mm, glabrous inside, hairy on the mid-line outside, dull red; disc glands 5; ovary glabrous, style ca 0.5 mm long. Fruits: pedicel 1.5–3 mm long; capsule ca 7 mm diam., with persistent calyx. Seeds globose, 5–6 mm diam.

description: Shrub or small tree, up to 5 m high; branchlets terete, pubescent. Stipules triangular, 1–1.5 mm long. Leaves: petiole 0.3–1(–1.5) cm long, subopposite, sparsely hairy, glabrescent, ribbed; blade elliptic, obovate or ovate, 8.4–15(–23.7) by 3–8(–9.1) cm, thinly chartaceous, base broadly cuneate or obtuse, margin entire, slightly undulate, apex acuminate, acute or cuspidate blunt, nerves in 7–10 pairs, venation trinerved at base. Inflorescences racemose, axillary, 4–4.5 cm long. Staminate flowers fasciculate; pedicel ca 2 mm long, glabrous; sepals 3 outer smaller, ovate, 1.3–1.5 by 0.8–1, hairy outside; petals ovate, 3–3.2 by 2.5–2.7, yellowish; stamens 3; staminal column very short, ca 0.1 mm long; anther 0.3–0.4 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 1.5-2 cm long; sepals oblong, 1.4–1.4 by 0.7–6.9; petals lanceolate, 1.5–2 by 1–1.5 mm, yellowish; disc annular; ovary hairy; style ca 0.1 mm long. Fruits: pedicel 3.5–4.5 cm long; capsule globose, axis 6–7 mm long. Seeds trigonous, 6–7 by ca 5 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree, up to 5 m high; branchlets ribbed, pubescent. Stipules triangular, 0.7–3 mm long. Leaves: petiole 1–2 cm long, densely pubescent; blade narrowly oblanceolate to oblanceolate or spathulate, 22–55 by 3–15 cm, chartaceous, glabrous above, pubescent beneath, base long attenuate, margin serrate, apex caudate-acuminate, nerves in 16–25 pairs, venation penninerved at base. Inflorescences spicate, axillary, uni- or bisexual, up to 28 cm long, hirsute; bracteoles linear or subulate, 2.5 by 0.3–0.4 mm, glabrous inside, setose or hairy outside. Staminate flowers: pedicel 1.5–2.5 mm long; sepals oblong, ca 1.8–2.5 by 1–1.4 mm, glabrous inside, hairy on the mid-line outside; petals ovate, 1.5–2 by 1.5 mm, glabrous, dark purple; disc glands 5; stamens 3 with large appendages; staminal column 1–1.3 mm long; anther 0.6–0.7 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 3.7–4.5 mm long; sepals lanceolate, ca 2.5 by 1.2–1.3 mm, glabrous inside, hairy outside; petals broadly obovate, 2.8–3 by 2.1–2.3 mm; disc annular; ovary hirsute; styles ca 0.1 mm long. Fruits: pedicel 4–6 mm; capsule depressed globose, ca 1 cm diam., axis 7–8 mm long, hairy. Seeds trigonous, 7–8 by 4–5 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree, 1–2 m high; branchlets terete, strigose, glabrescent. Stipules triangular, 0.7 mm long. Leaves: petiole 3–7 mm long, glabrescent; blade oblanceolate or oblong oblanceolate, 7.5–14.2 by 2.3–4 cm, chartaceous, pseudo-verticillate, glabrous and shining above, strigose along midrib beneath, base obtuse or truncate, margin slightly denticulate, apex shortly and bluntly acuminate or obtuse, nerves in 13–17 pairs, venation penninerved, hairy, glabrescent. Inflorescences racemose, axillary, up to 5 cm long, pubescent; bracteoles ovate, 5.5–8.5 by 1–2 mm long, oblanceolate or narrowly elliptic, sparsely hairy inside, hairy outside, glabescent. Staminate flowers: pedicel 3.5–4 mm long; sepals linear or lanceolate, 1.8–2 by 0.6–0.7 mm, glabrous inside, hairy outside; petals oblong-obovate, 3.5–3.7 by 1.7–1.8 mm, sparsely ciliate on both sides, purplish-red; disc glands 5; stamens 3; staminal column ca 0.6 mm long; anthers 0.25–0.35 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 4–6 mm long; sepals lanceolate, 5–8 by 1–2 mm, glabrous inside, pubescent outside; petals elliptic or obovate oblong. 2–3 by 1.5 mm, hairy; disc glands 5; ovary pubescent; style minute. Fruits unknown.

description: Shrub, up to 1.5 m high; branchlets ribbed, pilose, glabrescent. Stipules subulate, 0.6–0.8 mm long. Leaves: petiole 5–25 mm long, blade narrowly elliptic or oblanceolate, 12–26 by 3 6.5 cm, glabrous above, pilose beneath, base truncate or rounded, margin revolute, minutely denticulate, apex acuminate, acute or subobtuse, nerves in 11–17 pairs, venation penninerved. Inflorescences abbreviated, up to 4 cm long; bracteoles oblanceolate or spathulate, 3–3.8 by 0.7–1 mm, glabrous inside, hairy outside. Staminate flowers: pedicel 4.3–4.5 mm long; sepals ovate, 1.8–2 by 1.7–1.8 mm, glabrous inside, hairy outside, rim fimbriate; petals oblanceolate, 6.2–6.3 by ca 2.5 mm; disc glands 5, spathulate; stamens 5; staminal column ca 2 mm long; anthers 0.5–0.8 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 4–10 mm long; sepals elliptic ovate, 5–6 by 2–3 mm; petals oblong, 8–10 by 3–4 mm, glabrous inside, hairy outside, red; disc glands 5, spathulate; ovary tomentose; style 2.5 mm long. Fruit unknown.

description: Small tree, up to 6 m high; branchlets pubescent. Stipules triangular, 1.7–2.8 by 2.2–3.5 mm. Leaves: petiole (0.5–)4.5–10 cm long, pubescent, glabrescent; blade ovate-lanceolate or elliptic, (7–)12.5–26 by (2–)4.5–6 cm, chartaceous, base obtuse or rounded, margin minutely denticulate, apex acuminate, glabrous above, glabrous to very thinly pubescent beneath, nerves in 9–10 pairs, venation trinerved at base. Inflorescences paniculate, axillary, up to 8 cm long, pubescent; bracteoles linear or oblong, 3–5 mm long. Staminate flowers: pedicel ca 3 mm long, finely puberulous; sepals ovate, 1.5–2.1 by 2.5–2.9 mm, rim fimbriate; petals ovate, 3–3.2 by 2.8–3 mm; disc annular; stamens 3; staminal column ca 0.3 mm long; anther ca 0.7 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel ca 10 mm long; sepals ovate, 5–8 by 1–1.2 mm, subcordate at base, with 3 parallel median nerves, finely and sparsely pilose; petals 5, ovate, 1–5 mm long, rim ciliate; disc annular; ovary finely puberulous; style ca 0.6 mm long. Fruits: pedicel ca 10 mm long; capsule smooth, with finely puberulous, ca 12 mm long, with accrescent calyx, ca 17 mm long. Seeds globose, 7–8 mm diam.

description: Shrub or small tree, up to 7 m high; branchlets terete, sparsely hairy or glabrescent. Stipules triangular, ca 1 mm long. Leaves: petiole (1–)1.5–4(–5.7) cm long, sparsely hairy; blade broadly elliptic-oblong, (7.5–)10–20(–28) by (2.8–) 4–7.5(–8.5) cm, chartaceous, base rounded or broadly cuneate, margin entire with sparse hairs, apex caudate acuminate, nerves in 5–12 pairs, venation trinerved and 2 glands at base, venation pubescent, glabrescent. Inflorescences paniculate, axillary, up to 32 cm long, pubescent; peduncle 1–6 cm long; bracteoles narrowly oblong, 7–10 by 0.6–1.2 mm. Staminate flowers: pedicel 3.7–5 mm long; sepals ovate, 1.7–2.2 by 1.2–1.5 mm sparsely hairy outside, rim fimbriate; petals obovate, ca 3 by 1.5 mm, glabrous, yellow; stamens 3; staminal column ca 1 mm long; anthers ca 0.4 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 5–15 mm long; sepals ovate, 1.8–3.1 by 0.8–1.5 mm, hirsute outside; petals oblong, 2.5–3.7 by 1.8–2.1 mm, yellow; disc annular; ovary pubescent; style ca 0.7 mm long. Fruits: pedicel 1.5–2 cm; capsule depressed globose, ca 1 cm diam., thinly adpressed pubescent. Seeds globose, 7–8 mm diam.

description: Shrub, up to 1.5 m high; branchlets pubescent, glabrescent. Stipules triangular, 0.8–1 mm long. Leaves: petiole 0.8–1.9 cm long, sparsely hairy; blade narrowly or broadly oblong, oblanceolate or ovate lanceolate, 5.5–12 by 1.1–4 cm, chartaceous, hairy on both sides, base obtuse, margin glandular serrulate, apex acute or acuminate, nerves in 8–12 pairs, trinerved at base. Inflorescences racemose, axillary, 9–14 cm long. Staminate flowers: pedicel 1–2 cm long; sepals obovate, 2–3 by 1–2 mm, hairy outside; petals oblanceolate or obovate, 4–5 by 2–3 mm, dark red; disc cupular, undulate; stamens 3; staminal column 1–1.5 mm long; anther 0.5–0.8 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 0.8–1.5 mm long; sepals 5, oblong, 2–5 by 1–1.5 mm, sparsely hairy outside; petals 5, obovate, 4–5 by 1–2 mm, dark red, ovate; disc cupular; ovary pubescent; style ca 0.5 mm long. Fruits: pedicel ca 1.5–3.5 cm long; capsule globose, pubescent, 1–1.4 cm diam. Seeds globose, 5–6 mm long.

description: Shrub or small tree, up to 6 m high; branchlets sparsely hairy, glabrescent. Stipules triangular, ca 1 mm long. Leaves: petiole very variable, (2.5–)7.5–14 cm long, sparsely hairy; blade obovate, oblong-elliptic, broadly elliptic, lanceolate or oblong lanceolate, (10.5–)13–24 by 3.5–9.5 cm, membranous or thinly chartaceous, glabrous on both sides, base cuneate or subobtuse, margin broadly distantly and shallowly crenate, apex acute or caudate acute, nerves in 9–15 pairs, trinerved at base, venation sparsely hairy, glabrescent. Inflorescences pyramidal thyrsoides, terminal, up to 20 cm long, adpressed puberulous, branches angled or flattened. Staminate flowers: pedicel 2–5 mm long; sepals ovate-elliptic, ca 1.5 by 1 mm, pubescent outside, margin membranous; petals oblong, 3–3.5 by 1.8–2 mm, glabrous, yellow; disc glands 5, obovate-oblong; stamens 5, ca 1.5 mm long; staminal column minute, ca 1 mm long; anthers ca 0.25 mm long, with appendage ca 0.25 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 3.5–4 mm long; sepals ovate-elliptic, ca 1.5 by 0.8–1 mm long, pubescent outside, margin membranous; petals oblong, ca 4 mm by 1–1.5 mm, glabrous, yellow; disc glands 5; ovary glabrous; style ca 0.1 mm long. Fruits: pedicel 2.7–4.2 cm; capsule 1.2–1.5 cm diam., sparsely and shortly aculeate. Seeds slightly globose, 6–7 mm diam.

description: Shrub or small tree, up to 6 m high; branchlets terete or ribbed, glabrescent. Stipules triangular, 1–2 mm long. Leaves: petiole (1.5–)4–13(–20) cm long, glabrous; blade ovate-elliptic or narrowly elliptic, 12–33 by 2.5–8.5 cm, crowded towards tips of branchlets, chartaceous to coriaceous, glabrous, base rounded or cuneate, margin entire, apex acuminate; nerves in 9–21 pairs, venation penninerved at base. Inflorescences simple, narrowly pseudo-racemose, axillary, up to 20 cm long, glabrous or puberulous; bracteoles linear or ovate, 1.2–1.3 by ca 0.5 mm, hairy. Staminate flowers: pedicel 1.2–1.3 mm long; sepals ovate, ca 2 by 1.6 mm, margin fimbriate; petals ovate-spathulate, 3–3.2 by 2.2–3 mm, margin fimbriate, glabrous, dark purple; disc annular; stamens 5; staminal column 1.1–1.2 mm long; anther 1–1.2 mm long. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 2–3 mm long; sepals ovate, ca 2 by 1.5 mm; petals ovate lanceolate, ca 3 by 2.5 mm, dark purple; disc urceolate; ovary velutinous, style ca 0.6 mm long. Fruits: pedicel 2–3.5 mm long; capsule glabrous, ca 1 cm diam., axis 3.5–4 mm long, usually finely and very shortly velutinous, rarely glabrous. Seeds globose, 4.5–6 mm diam.

description: Shrub or tree, up to 20 m high; monoecious, deciduous with flowers appearing before the leaves. Stipules 4–12 by 2–4 mm. Leaves: petiole (5.5–)20(–26) cm long, glands at apex sessile, tuberculiform or cushion-shaped; blades not to shallowly 3-lobed, (4.5–)10–25 by (3.5–)10–22 cm, length/width ratio 1-1.2(–1.4), apex subacute to obtusely acuminate to slightly cuspidate, ending in a small gland. Inflorescences usually bisexual, (3–)8–16 by 7-21 cm, few flowered. Flowers 25–30 by 25–35 mm in diam., reddish-white to purple, suffused and veined with pink, yellow in the centre; calyx lobes 8–10 by 5–8 mm; petals orbicular-ovate to broadly spathulate, 20–35 by 8–20 mm, claw 3–6 by 1.5–2 mm. Staminate flowers: pedicel 8–18 mm long; disc glands subulate to triangular-elliptic, 3–4.5 by 0.5–1 mm, acute, somewhat fleshy; stamens (7)8(–14), the (4)5(–8) outer ones 7–10 mm long, the 3(–6) inner ones 11–15 mm long; anthers 1.5–2 by 0.5–1 mm. Pistillate flowers: pedicel 5–14 mm long; disc glands as staminate flowers, 2–4 by 0.8–1.0 mm; ovary 4(5)-locular, ovoid-subglobose, 4–5 by 3–4 mm; styles 4–5 mm long, shortly bifid. Fruits spherical to subglobose or slightly compressed, apically sharply pointed, basally stiped, abruptly narrowed into the base, surface smooth or faintly lineate, but without any grooves or ridges: 4–6 by 3–5 cm in diam., dull brown when ripe, glabrescent. Seeds 20–25(–30) by 18–22 by 14–15 mm, conspicuously warty and ridged dorsally and ventrally.

description: Shrub or tree, up to 15 m high, dbh up to 22 cm; monoecious, evergreen. Stipules 3–5 by 2–3 mm. Leaves: petiole 4.5–15(–23) cm long, glands at apex club-shaped, turbinate, tip cup shaped; blades not or very often 3- or 5-lobed, (6–)10–20(–27) by (4–)10–20(–28) cm, length/width ratio 1–1.4, apex and lobes acutely acuminate to slightly cuspidate, without a gland at the top. Inflorescences usually unisexual, staminate ones many-flowered, (10–)15–25 by 15–32 cm; pistillate inflorescences significantly smaller, (3–)5–12 by 4–15 cm. Flowers very fragrant, white, reddish-brown in the centre; calyx green at base, the whole deep pink to pinkish-yellow, lobes 10–15 by 5–8 mm; petals narrowly obovate-spathulate, 15–35 by 6–10(–15) mm, claw 6– 8 by 1.5–2 mm. Staminate flowers 15–35 mm in diam.; pedicel 7–12 mm long; disc glands subulate or cylindrical-fusiform, slenderly triangular in outline, very long and acute, 3–4.5 by 0.3–0.5 mm, somewhat fleshy; stamens (8–)10–12(–14); filaments pale light greenish to faintly pinkish, 5–9 outer 10–16 mm long, 3–5(–8) longer inner ones 12–21 mm long; anthers 2–2.5 by 1–1.5 mm, light yellow. Pistillate flowers: 20–30 mm in diam.; pedicel rather short, stout, 3–6 mm long; disc glands shorter and wider than in the staminate flowers, 1–2 by 0.7–1 mm; ovary obovoid or ellipsoid and angular, 3(–5)-locular, 4–5 by 3–4 mm; styles 5–10 mm long. Fruits ovoid to subglobose with rounded-truncate base, apiculate at apex, surface wrinkled with 3(–5) distinct longitudinal grooves and ridges with few transverse ribs, 4–6 by 4–4.5 cm in diam., sparingly pubescent, yellow. Seeds broadly obovate in dorsal view, pointed at the micropylar end, 20–30 by 20–25 by 11–15 mm, conspicuously warty and ridged dorsally and ventrally.

description: Tree, up to 27 m high. Stipules 6–12 by 2.6–4mm. Leaves: petiole 0.6–1.5 cm long; blade 9.5–56 by 4–21.5 cm, length/width ratio 2.6–3.2, apex tapering acuminate to cuspidate, tip often mucronulate, glands more or less in line at ca ⅓ from margin, nerves in 19–32 pairs. Inflorescences: staminate ones up to 42 cm long, pistillate ones up to 90 cm long. Staminate flowers white or cream, 5–5.5 mm in diam.; pedicel 2.6–8 mm long, (sub)hirsute; sepals 2.8–3.1 by 1.3–3.2 mm; stamens: filaments 2.8–3 mm long, creamish-white; anthers 0.8–1.2 by 0.7–1 mm, connective without or with very short apical appendage less than 0.2 mm long. Pistillate flowers green to greenish-yellow, 2.8–4.8 mm in diam.; pedicel up to 10 mm long, hirsute; sepals 1.5–3.2 by 0.3–2 mm; ovary 2.6–4.6 mm in diam., style 0.2–2 mm long; stigmas 3(4), 5.8–13 mm long, split after 0.1–3 mm. Fruits 1.3–1.7 by 0.6–1 cm, outside creamish-white to grey tomentose, green to yellowish-green when immature. Seeds 6–9 mm in diam.; embryo ca 8 by 7 by 6 mm.
